name: noisy
description: Noisy Room task-document, skill-management, and task-monitoring workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Task documents, local skills, and task monitoring.
interface.longDescription: Noisy provides durable task markdown workflows, scope-aware GitHub source registries for project-local skill installation, updates, and recovery, and a Luna chat that monitors a work run and reports back once.
defaultPrompt: $noisy:tmd create a task doc use 1.md as reference
$noisy:watch-task Create a Luna watcher for my current task and send one status message back here when it finishes or is interrupted.
